notes: ACCESS: Direct HTTP fetch (tier a) with a real Chrome UA - all pages HTTP 200, no block encountered. robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows only specific paths (/*/search, /*?start, /*?cgid, /*?prefn etc.) which do not cover the clean category paths used here, and does not name any Claude/anthropic bot, so no restriction applied. Also test-rendered several pages with Playwright (tier b) to check for JS-only counts; the site's Algolia InstantSearch widget (#algolia-hits-placeholder) never hydrated in headless Chromium even after accepting the OneTrust cookie banner and scrolling - but this did not matter because the plain server-rendered HTML (no JS needed) already contains the full product grid plus an authoritative 'NNN Results' block (SFCC grid-footer, also carries data-page-size and a Search-UpdateGrid sz= pagination URL confirming the same total). All qty values below come from that server-rendered span via tier (a) alone. TREE: built from the union of the /uk/department/home/ mega-menu (header slideout links for each level-2 node: Discover, Home Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Home Furnishings, Shop By Room, Brands) and sitemap_5-category.xml (which revealed Bedding's and Bathroom Towels' child subcategories that are NOT exposed anywhere in the mega-menu). Every candidate leaf's h1/category-id hidden input was checked against the requested slug to rule out a wrong-node/parent-total substitution. QTY METHOD: server-rendered total-number-of-results span, read directly from the HTML returned by a plain GET (see evidence per row). EXCLUDED and why: Wallpaper and Footstools & Furniture (Home Furnishings siblings - wall covering / furniture, not textile or storage); Candles & Candle Holders, Wall Art, Vases, Decorative Plates & Trays, Ornaments, Lighting, Stationery and Games (Home Accessories siblings - decorative/other, not storage - none are genuine storage/organization categories); Tableware, Mugs, Glasses & Drinksware, Cookware, Kitchen Accessories (Kitchen & Dining - Kitchen Accessories is a single mixed 46-item category with a few tea-towel/apron products inside it but no dedicated Tea Towels/Aprons/Kitchen Textiles subcategory node to record, so it was left out entirely rather than extracting at product level); Shop By Room (Bedroom/Bathroom/Living Room/Kitchen) - these are cross-category room-landing aggregator pages pulling the same products already counted under Home Furnishings/Home Accessories, not standalone category nodes, so including them would double-count; Brands (a brand directory, not a product category). Furnishing Fabrics was included even though its canonical URL redirects to the separate /uk/department/fabrics/ (Fabrics) department - it is directly and only linked from the Home Furnishings mega-menu as 'Furnishing Fabrics' and is explicitly a home/furnishing fabric per rule, not apparel/dressmaking fabric (the rest of the Fabrics department - Cotton, Silk, Viscose, Shop by Usage, Shop by Pattern, Collections, Wallpaper - is genuinely a separate apparel/dressmaking-fabric and wallpaper department and was left out of scope). Bedding (303 Results on its own page) and Bathroom Towels (47 Results on its own page) each have valid subcategories, so per the parent-URL rule only their subcategory leaves carry qty/link; the parent is recorded as a grouping row only (its own higher total includes uncategorized items sitting directly under the parent bucket, which is expected and not an error).
